correctness.rationale: In K_{a,b} with d>=2 i.i.d. uniform offers with replacement, each move deterministically changes part and new-target discovery probability is 1-(j/n)^d regardless of particular seen labels. A coupled greedy count chain proves optimality for every deadline against all adaptive randomized choices. The alternating independent offer streams yield C_A=max(2U_a,2U_b+1), C_B=max(2U_b,2U_a+1), where U_n starts with one coupon collected and equals sum_{r=1}^{n-1} Geom(1-(1-r/n)^d). Parity CDFs follow. Log-concavity of geometric masses, TP2 convolution and strict parameter monotonicity give likelihood-ratio order U_a>=lr U_b, hence strict even-time gap exactly k>=a-1 for a>b. Coupling maxima gives mean gap P(U_a>U_b)-P(U_a<U_b) in (0,1], equality 1 exactly b=1. Independent exact-rational labeled-mask process matched partwise collector CDFs for K_3,2 at d=2 and d=3 through nine traversals; at t=4 d2 larger-start CDF=10/27 and d3=1729/2916, versus 0 from smaller start. Finite checks are not proof of all sizes or MLR.
